pool.text: Yu Prefecture was renamed to Gong Prefecture during the Northern Song.
The city received its current name after Prince Zhao Dun described a double celebration.
Peasant rebel leader Ming Yuzhen established the short-lived Daxia Kingdom at Chongqing.
She Chongming established the short-lived kingdom of Daliang with Chongqing as its capital.
Chongqing and Sichuan were captured by Zhang Xianzhong after the fall of the Ming dynasty.
The British Consulate General was opened in Chongqing.
Chongqing served as the wartime capital of the Republic of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War.
Chongqing was formally declared the second capital city of the Republic of China.
Mao Zedong signed the Double 10 Peace Agreement with the Kuomintang at Guiyuan.
The first important bridge in urban Chongqing, the Niujiaotuo Jialing River Bridge, was built.
The Shibanpo Yangtze River Bridge was built as the first bridge over the Yangtze.
A soccer club originally called Qianwei Wuhan was formed to take part in the professional Chinese Soccer League.
The current municipality was separated from Sichuan province to further regional development.
The soccer club achieved its greatest success by winning the Chinese FA Cup.
A station was completed and connected to the Metro Line in Chongqing.
Chongqing had an annual output capacity of 1 million cars and 8.6 million motorcycles.
Chongqing became one of the nine National Central Cities in China.
The Chongqing Soaring Dragons became the 20th team playing in the Chinese Basketball Association.
The Chongqing Soaring Dragons basketball team moved to Beijing and is known as Beijing Royal Fighters.
The Chengdu Military Region was reorganized into the Western Theater Command.
